endorsements.name: Snir Ben-Shimol
endorsements.label: Unmasking stealth operations using UBA super powers
endorsements.description: The problem of evasive threats is rapidly gaining steam. The advanced techniques of composing stealth operations that were once possible only for the most sophisticated state-actors, turned out to be more common. Slow and low attack techniques, lateral movement and sophisticated data exfiltration methods are only a few of the new challenges outmaneuvering enterprise security. By leveraging behavioral analytics and machine learning capabilities using only event logs, we can identify such evasions and protect against both adversaries and insiders.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2018
